# Getting help

FrameDecks is maintained by a small team. These steps get you an answer fastest.

## 1. Look in the documentation

| If you want to… | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Find any guide | [Documentation index](../docs/README.md) |
| Fix something that isn't working | [Troubleshooting](../docs/guide/troubleshooting.md) |
| Find a quick answer | [FAQ](../docs/guide/faq.md) |
| Install or update | [Installation](../docs/guide/installation.md) |
| Set up the phone remote | [Remote control](../docs/guide/remote-control.md) |
| Prepare a volunteer | [Ministry team guides](../docs/guide/roles/README.md) |

## 2. During a live service

Don't troubleshoot on air. Use the recovery steps in [Troubleshooting](../docs/guide/troubleshooting.md):

- **Hide all** (Esc) clears everything on screen.
- **Blackout** (K) gives a black picture while you sort things out.
- The program keeps running in the background if you close its window; reopen it from the icon near the clock.

Afterwards, report what happened with the **Service-day problem** issue form so it can be fixed for next week.

## 3. Write to us

Write to **hello@framedecks.com** (users), or open an issue in this private repository (the team), choosing
**Bug report**, **Feature request** or **Service-day problem**.

Please include:

- the version (**Settings → About**);
- your Windows version;
- **Settings → Diagnostics → Copy diagnostics**, pasted into your message. It contains no PIN and no member details, but
  read it before posting.

Please never post:

- your phone-remote PIN;
- member names, phone numbers, emails or birthdays;
- your ESV API key;
- screenshots that show any of the above.

## Security problems

Report security problems privately. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
